name: guarded-tasks-are-bounded
description: T1, V2, X6: MAX_GUARDED_FOR (19) is a hard bound on every proposal, counting its proposer and executor whether guarded or not: a proposal whose guardedFor (carried(proposer) and carried(executor) included) with its proposer and executor would hold more than 19 agents is denied; a task's guardedFor may hold at most 17, so a proposer and an executor always fit; closing a task makes room

steps.note: V4: 20 tasks assigned, none accepted: they burden nothing
17 carried, then the executor; with the proposer M, 19 agents: at the bound
V2: 18 carried, M and X make 20, though M is never guarded
X3: M executes, so carried(M) joins t19's agent
X6: a parentless task records carried(M), 19 agents; a task may hold 17
the named task's agents first, then carried(executor) in the order the tasks were created (X3)
X2: work named under an unlinked task carries that task's guarding, not carried(M)
V1, X6: a parentless task records carried(author): 17, at the task bound
